title: Arc Binding — Campbell Stage → Propp Functions (macro ↔ meso)
tier_note: Binds the macro arc to the meso grammar: each Campbell stage maps to the Propp functions that typically realize it. Priors, not laws — a stage may realize via other functions or none. Empty `propp_function_ids` marks a psychological/transitional stage with no direct Propp counterpart.

items.name: Call to Adventure → Villainy/Lack + Mediation
items.description: The disturbance that launches the plot: harm or lack, made known.

items.name: Refusal of the Call → (no direct function)
items.description: Hesitation preceding the decision to counteract; psychological, not a Propp move.

items.name: Supernatural Aid → Donor + Receipt of Agent
items.description: The mentor tests and bestows the magical agent.

items.name: Crossing the First Threshold → Departure
items.description: The hero leaves the known world and is guided toward the object.

items.name: Belly of the Whale → Guidance
items.description: Full passage into the unknown; transference to the site of trial.

items.name: The Road of Trials → Hero's Reaction + Struggle
items.description: Tests and combats the hero must survive and learn from.

items.name: Meeting with the Goddess → Receipt of Agent
items.description: Encounter with a giving power; the hero gains what is needed.

items.name: Woman as Temptress → Trickery + Complicity
items.description: Temptation and deception that may divert the hero.

items.name: Atonement with the Father → Struggle + Branding
items.description: Confrontation with the ultimate authority; the hero is marked.

items.name: Apotheosis → Victory
items.description: The adversary is overcome; the hero transcends former limits.

items.name: The Ultimate Boon → Liquidation
items.description: The goal is achieved; the initial lack is resolved.

items.name: Refusal of the Return → (no direct function)
items.description: Reluctance to return; psychological, not a Propp move.

items.name: The Magic Flight → Return + Pursuit
items.description: Escape with the boon, sometimes as a chase.

items.name: Rescue from Without → Rescue
items.description: Aides bring the wounded or reluctant hero back.

items.name: Return Threshold → Unrecognized Arrival
items.description: Re-entry into the ordinary world, often unrecognized.

items.name: Master of Two Worlds → Recognition + Transfiguration
items.description: The hero is recognized and transfigured; balance achieved.

items.name: Freedom to Live → Wedding
items.description: Reward and resolution; the hero is elevated and free.
